product_metadata.title: Halter Floating Shelves Wall Mounted for Home Decor Storage, Set of 3, Brown
features: Multipurpose and versatile; Give any interior an entirely different look with this great addition to your collection of stylish shelves; This three-piece ledge set offers a lot of versatility for creating an artful display, and functionality as storage of home or work essentials

Functional yet stylish; Bring life to any room with your favorite decorative pieces on display; or conveniently store any items you need at the ready; With its rustic, industrial-themed design, it can blend well with any modern contemporary interior

Sturdy yet lightweight; Made from light yet durable wood and rust-resistant metal mount for support, using it is a great way to hold and showcase your items securely; Use this as a bookshelf in your reading nook, or as a spice rack in the kitchen

Uniquely designed to be concealed as floating, its hidden mounting system utilizes your wall space efficiently so you don’t have to put decorative items on a table; Easy to clean and maintain; Can be easily wiped off with a damp cloth
